topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: When I moved the old rug in the far corner of the basement, I noticed the floorboards were slightly different. My heart raced as I pried one up, revealing a small, dark space beneath. Inside, I found a locked box, cold and heavy with secrets. The air grew thick and my hands trembled as I tried to pry it open, but it wouldn’t budge. What if the previous owners didn’t want this found? What if I’m not supposed to know what’s inside? I need to find a way to open this, I have to know what they were hiding.
